# QR encoder

`qrcodegen.js` is Project Nayuki's MIT-licensed QR Code generator, downloaded on 2026-10-09 from https://www.nayuki.io/res/qr-code-generator-library/qrcodegen.js.

The original license header is preserved. Mosaic adds only `export { qrcodegen };` for local ES module loading. No login ticket is sent to an image-generation service.
